model.name: sex-specific logistic (preferred)
model.formula: logit(p) = β0 + β1 * log(female) + β2 * log(male)

diagnostics.model_comparison: Sex-specific vs total-gametocyte: AIC total=112.3, AIC sex=105.0, ΔAIC=7.3 (prefer sex-specific).
diagnostics.asexual_assessment: LRT statistic=0.64, p=0.423: asexual density does NOT add significant predictive value.
diagnostics.calibration: Calibration intercept=-0.153, slope=0.826; perfect calibration would give intercept 0, slope 1.

literature.claim: Total gametocyte density predicts mosquito infection; relationship can be modelled with logistic dose-response.
literature.citation: Churcher TS, et al. Predicting mosquito infection from Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte density. eLife, 2013.

literature.claim: Female (Pfs25) and male (PfMGET) gametocyte densities are both required for fertilisation; sex-specific measurements improve transmission predictions.
literature.citation: Schneider P, et al. Quantification of female and male P. falciparum gametocytes by quantitative reverse transcriptase PCR. Mol Biochem Parasitol, 2015.

literature.claim: Molecular markers SBP1 (asexual), Pfs25 (female gametocyte) and PfMGET (male gametocyte) accurately quantify parasite stages in feeding experiments.
literature.citation: Meerstein-Kessel L, et al. Multiplex qPCR assay for detection and quantification of Plasmodium falciparum sexual and asexual parasites. Sci Rep, 2018.
